parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, no documented police targeting of trans people, no facility or border restriction reaching visitors, and societal attitudes recorded as broadly neutral — the 2015 activist statement (dated) said the community is not targeted by violence as elsewhere in the region. Positives: a constitutional court struck down the registration barrier in 2017, showing institutions that can rule for the community. But acceptance is described as neutral, not warm; there is no documented visitor-facing remedy (Art. 191/160 have no recorded prosecutions — paper only); employment protections were repealed in 2023/24 and a 2024 opposition campaign framed minorities as an issue, a backsliding climate signal. Entry document handling, custody placement and care access are simply undocumented — open questions, not exposures. This sits in the Reduced Risk band, below dossiers with demonstrated working service protections.
